edits.old: BR9 is the order in which the Section B grants are applied, and this story is the one that applies them.
edits.new:
BR9 is the order in which the Section B grants are applied, and this story is the one that applies them.

The view conformance test of RWB-E1-069 ('Read-only ACE grant', version 4 section 10) sits with this P1 DB slice, the only holder of the grant. The P4 slice keeps the role and masking checks, and the per-service boundary test is the cross-schema check.

disposition.target: FSD P1 A1.3 and TSD P1 T6.3
disposition.change: Publish the Tier 1 ACE table list (the 21 names, or the name of the 22nd table), confirmed by the ACE team lead.
disposition.note: Story keeps the 21 named tables and the legacy grant block. The count conflict is raised to the ACE team lead.

disposition.change: Record the masking version naming rule with the pack owner (year and month, as PM-2026.12). Label MASK-2026.12 stays until the pack owner confirms the real label at load time.
disposition.note: No source fixes the masking version label. The naming rule belongs in TSD P4 T3.1.

disposition.target: Platform DB story and Environment and Deployment Design
disposition.change: Fix the 19 per-service login names and replace the rwb-access login placeholder in the privilege test with the fixed name.
disposition.note: The rwb-access login name is owned by the platform DB story and the Environment and Deployment Design, not this story.

disposition.target: TSD P4 T3.1 and physical schema note
disposition.change: Record masking_rule.field_id as a dictionary field ID value with no cross-schema key. The dictionary stays with the P1 data-dictionary API and is not duplicated.
disposition.note: The narrow reading is taken. The rwb-access schema belongs to TSD P4, not this story.

disposition.target: Per-service module map and service template (BND-6 wording)
disposition.change: Publish the module map with an explicitly empty source-object list for the 18 services that read no view. Fix the BND-6 failure wording once in the service template.
disposition.note: BR8 already reads the allowed views from the module map. The map itself is not in any target document.

disposition.change: Added a paragraph after the BR9 sentence: the view conformance test sits with this P1 DB slice as grant holder; P4 keeps role and masking checks; boundary test is the cross-schema check.
disposition.note: This story holds the view conformance test. The split is recorded in section 8.

disposition.change: Keep the five version 4 dependency rows visible as Not carried. Add an X row later only if run books or the harness wait for the named story.
disposition.note: The five rows are for other legacy stories. They are not dependencies of this story, so no story text changes.
Section 7 and 16 text is not in this chunk, so AC9 cannot be anchored. BR1-4 and BR7-9 are already covered, and BR5-6 belong to other stories.
